sample.title: Pneumonia
sample.instructions:
Dx: Community-acquired pneumonia.
Meds: Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875-125 mg PO BID x 5 more days. Azithromycin 250 mg PO daily x 3 more days. Finish all antibiotics even if you feel better.
Albuterol inhaler 2 puffs q4-6h PRN wheeze/SOB.
Home: Rest, drink plenty of fluids. Use incentive spirometer 10x/hour while awake. No smoking.
F/u with PCP.
Seek care for: fever returns, worsening cough, confusion, lips turning blue, trouble breathing.

plan.reason_for_stay: You were treated for pneumonia, a lung infection.

key_points.text: Take your antibiotics for the full time, even if you feel better.
key_points.source: Finish all antibiotics even if you feel better.

key_points.text: Rest and drink plenty of fluids.
Use your incentive spirometer 10 times an hour while you are awake.

medications.source: Azithromycin 250 mg PO daily x 3 more days.
